640-2228-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
640-2228-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
640-2228-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

874-1170-1329-8201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2267-3240-4247-6462.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1643-2073-4659-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

5109-7721.easyPrerequisites:
You haven't deal damage due to The Sensational She-Hulk's triggered ability this turn.
An opponent has less life than you.
5109-7721.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion equal to an opponent's life total.
The Incredible She-Hulk triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.
5109-7721.notes: You may choose any creature you control to deal damage to. Volcano Hellion is used for simplicity sake.

283-2060-4186-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Scurry Oak
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve both Ghave abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-5931.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-5931.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1350-2793-5231-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {R}. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2457-3000-4365-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

740-6712-6781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
740-6712-6781.description:
Cast Grand Crescendo by paying {W}{W}, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-4010-4785-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-4785-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1329-2178-2921-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2921-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2099-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2099-4321-5777.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-2179-4993-5897.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Manifold Key's ability, targeting Sonic Screwdriver.
Resolve both Manifold Key abilities, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Sonic Screwdriver.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sonic Screwdriver's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Sonic Screwdriver's ability, targeting Manifold Key.
Resolve both Sonic Screwdriver abilities, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Manifold Key.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead.

1636-3143-3197.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-3143-3197.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

1269-4050-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {1}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Exhume by paying {1}{B}, causing each player to return a creature card from their graveyard to the battlefield, with you choosing to return Cormela.
Repeat.

1847-2034-2608-3169.description:
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping The Golden Throne.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

877-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {0} due to Morophon.
When Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-4549-4630.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other legendary creatures.
1636-4549-4630.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' first ability by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability four times by tapping Sisay and three other legendary creatures you control, adding {U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for a legendary creature card with mana value less than Sisay's power and putting it onto the battlefield.
The legendary creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability five times by tapping Sisay and four other legendary creatures you control, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
 Repeat from step 3.

4929-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
4929-5220-5243.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.
